titre: Yellowjackets Season 4 Episode 1 Ending Explained: What Did Natalie See?
chapo: 'Yellowjackets' has already thrown a twist at the audience in its premiere episode with a third timeline. What is happening at camp?
extrait: One of the greatest things about showrunners Ashley Lyle and Bart Nickerson’s psychological horror show Yellowjackets is that you never know what bananas shenanigans will happen next. We’re only one episode into Yellowjackets season 4, and we’re happy to report that this still holds true, with a cliffhanger ending that will leave you wondering what the hell just happened. At the end of season 3, teen Natalie (Sophie Thatcher) had just managed to contact someone outside the remote wilderness using the satellite phone they’d recovered from the scientific expedition that had recently discovered them. Back at the camp, teen Shauna (Sophie Nélisse), now in charge, is furious at Natalie for calling for help behind her back. This article contains spoilers for Yellowjackets season 4 episode 1, “Hivemind.” It was established in the first season of Yellowjackets that the girls (and Travis) would eventually be rescued, as the time jumps between 2021 and 1996 make clear. However, the mystery was more about how that would happen and what the consequences of the Yellowjackets' rescue would be. In “Hivemind,” the outcome of that phone call is made pretty clear. The girls and Travis are rescued and brought to a hospital in Canada, though several are missing, including poor Mari Ibarra (Alexa Barajas), who ended up being skewered in the same pit she was previously rescued from during one of the girls’ cannibalistic hunts in season 3. This leads to a few emotional scenes of the parents of the dead breaking down and the survivors exchanging agonizingly guilty looks. At first, it looks like we’ll skip the immediate fallout as the rest of the Yellowjackets learn about Natalie’s call for help. Most of “Hivemind” in the teen timeline focuses on the reunion between the parents and survivors, and the teens’ efforts to cover up the deplorable things they did in the wilderness by lying to the ranger and therapist who question them. That is, until the end of the episode, when the story jumps back to the wilderness, before the rescue. We see Natalie stumble back into camp, wide-eyed and terrified. She then asks a question that I too say at the end of every Yellowjackets episode: “What the fuck?” Yellowjackets’ first episode may have ended on a truly diabolical cliffhanger, but that doesn’t mean we don’t have clues about what Natalie saw to make her react with so much shock. chapo: Review: As Yellowjackets enters Season 4, the end can’t come soon enough.
extrait: Spoilers follow for Yellowjackets Season 4, Episode 1 – “Hivemind,” which is streaming now on Paramount+. New episodes drop weekly on Fridays. In 2012, Showtime delivered Yellowjackets, its best original horror drama since Dexter. Featuring a female-led cast of middle-aged legends (Melanie Lynskey, Tawny Cypress, Christina Ricci, etc.) and mostly unknowns playing their younger selves, Yellowjackets earned instant buzz for its scary mix of survival horror, social hierarchy commentary and trauma manifestations. So it’s been hugely disappointing that the subsequent two seasons have only offered diminishing returns as creators Ashley Lyle and Bart Nickerson (Narcos) haven’t been able to extend the potency of their original premise into coherent and compelling past and present narratives walking into Season 4. As this is the final season, there was plenty of hope that the writing team would pour all of their reserved ideas into purposeful and emotionally rewarding narratives ignited by the plane crash survivors getting rescued from their feral, cannibalistic ways in the Canadian wilderness. Let’s be real: their return to society has long been past due as they’ve killed or eaten two-thirds of the cast. The fourth season premiere episode, “Hivemind,” crackles with the excitement of that anticipated reentry, told through 1998-era TV breaking news announcements, including Gen Z stalwart MTV News. But then Yellowjackets falls back into its bad habits, like leaning on needle drop montages to Nirvana’s “Where Did You Sleep Last Night” to show the broken and battered survivors being examined in the hospital, instead of giving them meaty scenes where they can process the moment with consequential words and deeds. The present day storyline picks up in the aftermath of Melissa’s (Hilary Swank) murder of Van (Lauren Ambrose). The formerly hidden in plain sight survivor grabs her wife Alex (Jaylee Hamidi) and young daughter to flee the retribution of Tai (Cypress), Shauna (Lynskey) and Misty (Ricci). However, that’s fear wasted because the trio are a rather listless group now. Tai and Misty don’t trust Shauna anymore so they’re quietly plotting, black comedy style, to make their unstable frenemy believably “disappear.” Shauna has ostracized everyone in her life, including her estranged husband Jeff (Warren Kole) and fellow murderous daughter Callie (Sarah Desjardins).
